forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: aa80
+title: 'Extras: a hang between the footprints publish under the pool lock and the stream termination handler'
+---
+## What
+Found in task 01M3HXT453GXVBZPZFXXTZGP9Y (^xtzgp9y). One run of `PooledResidencyTests/droppingLastHandleFreesBudgetForNextResolve` on FoundationModelsExtras f4bd503 did not end (about 1 run in 22). `sample` of the test process showed two threads that wait on `__ulock_wait2`:
+- Thread 1 (main): `Router.deinit` -> `PromptCacheSizing.deinit` (`footprintsTask.cancel()`) -> the `onTermination` closure of `ModelPool.footprints` (`ModelPool.swift:88`, `state.withLock { $0.streams[id] = nil }`) -> waits for the pool lock.
+- Thread 2: the eviction job `ModelPool.evictIfIdle` -> `state.withLock { $0.publish() }` -> `State.publish()` (`continuation.yield` under the pool lock) -> waits for a different lock.
+
+Probable cause (not proved): `Task.cancel()` runs the cancellation handler of the stream iterator while the runtime holds the status lock of the task. The handler calls `onTermination`, which takes the pool lock. At the same time `publish()` holds the pool lock and `yield` resumes the waiting `next()` of the same task, which needs the status lock of the task. Thus each thread holds the lock that the other thread needs.
+
+The code of `publish()` and `onTermination` is the same at ea9dc99, so the hang can occur there too. 25 runs of the test and 10 parallel runs of the pool suites on ea9dc99 did not show it.
+
+## Fix direction (Extras)
+Do not call `continuation.yield` while the pool lock is held, or do not take the pool lock in `onTermination` (for example, remove the stream from the dictionary on the next `publish` when `yield` returns `.terminated`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A test in Extras that cancels a `footprints` reader while the pool publishes, repeated many times, never hangs.
+- [ ] The router takes the fix with `swift package update FoundationModelsExtras`.
+
+#cross-repo #model-pool
\ No newline at end of file

--- original
+++ modified
@@ -1,6 +1,16 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m3j843e32fz0yg03x97ezx8h
+  text: |-
+    Proof, and the full router suite now hangs. At Extras ea9dc99 and at b189086 the root `swift test` hung in 2 of 2 full runs (after a clean build). `sample` of the test process at each hang shows the lock-order inversion exactly:
+    - Thread A: `Router.deinit` -> `PromptCacheSizing.deinit` (`footprintsTask.cancel()`) -> `swift_task_cancelImpl` -> `withStatusRecordLock` (holds the status lock of the footprints task) -> `AsyncStream._Storage.cancel` -> `onTermination` closure of `ModelPool.footprints` (`ModelPool.swift:88`) -> `_os_unfair_lock_lock_slow` (waits for the pool lock).
+    - Thread B: the eviction job (`Job.run` -> closure of `ModelPool.release` line 149 -> `evictIfIdle` line 160) -> `state.withLock { $0.publish() }` (holds the pool lock) -> `AsyncStream._Storage.yield` -> `UnsafeContinuation.resume` -> `swift_continuation_resumeImpl` -> `flagAsAndEnqueueOnExecutor` -> `updateStatusRecord` -> `withStatusRecordLock` (waits for the status lock of the footprints task).
+    Tests in which it hung: `SessionTreeRestorationToolWiringTests.restoredRootWrapsNonStringOutputToolInItsOwnBindingLayer` (ea9dc99) and `SessionTreeRestorationTests.restoreReportsRecordedToolsTheCallerDidNotSupply` (b189086). Both drop a router while its evictions run. Since c7691c0 the eviction job runs sooner after the release, so it overlaps the router release more often than at f4bd503.
+    A fix in Extras must not call `continuation.yield` while it holds a lock that `onTermination` takes (for example: copy the continuations under the lock and yield outside it, with a separate publish order lock that `onTermination` never takes; or remove a terminated stream without the pool lock).
+  timestamp: 2026-09-27T20:15:23.587009+00:00
